newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian forint ends steady vs dlr/mark basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian forint ends steady vs dlr/mark basket.

text.p: The Hungarian forint finished steady against the central bank's dollar/mark currency basket on Monday and weaker versus the dollar, reflecting the U.S. currency's gains against the mark, dealers said.

The forint finished at 198.92/97 to the dollar, compared to 198.60/65 at opening, but firmer than the day's low of around 199.20. The Hungarian currency remained stuck at the central bank's resistance level in slow trade.
The forint floats within the National Bank of Hungary's 4.5 percent wide intervention range against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.
